propositions: The live tickets branch .bridge_state/projects.json was overwritten with a rehearsal fixture containing nonexistent project keys LEG, ONE, TWO, ZERO instead of the canonical single-project state {version: 1, legacy_default: REB, projects: {}}.

The fetcher multi-project fan-out (story-1734) builds one JQL query per key in projects.json; when LEG is the first key, the query 'project = LEG AND status != "Done"' is syntactically valid but rejected by Jira because project LEG does not exist, causing ACLI to exit 1 and reconcile_once to raise.

The corruption arrived via ad-hoc git commits (9f1b2cff98, 275bd7507e) on the live tickets branch authored by the test-fixture git identity at 2026-08-14T19:18-0700, 21 minutes before the first consistent Reconcile Bridge failure at 2026-08-15T02:39Z.

The .bridge_state/projects.json write path (projects_store.set_project/remove_project) violates the store invariant by lacking a shared write lock, auto-commit, and auto-push, forcing ad-hoc hand-commits.
